summary: Tested the new Regime-Lab Asset-Korrelation feature end-to-end (backend API + frontend UI). All acceptance criteria from the review request met: GET returns {job,result} shape, POST requires admin (401), POST validates <2 symbols (400), job appears in /api/regime-lab/active with kind='correlation', 2nd POST while running returns 409, finished result contains pairs with ret_corr/agree_pct/score/ret_corr_holdout/agree_pct_holdout/n_holdout plus groups/symbols/detector. Frontend: Regime-Lab opens, regime-correlation block renders, scope chips (watchlist 25 / crypto 13 / selection N) update the start-button count, toggle shows result with matrix, all four metric chips present, stale warning appears when lab timeframe/days differ from result, Gruppe übernehmen sets coin selection (regime-coin-BTCUSDT -> 'opt-chip on') and shows success toast.

minor.issue: Observed one transient 502 from ingress while a long correlation job was finishing; subsequent manual curls returned 200 consistently. Test now retries 3x; not reproducible without load.

critical_code_review_comments: asset_correlation.run excludes _id properly (via latest() pop) and uses async/await for DB and asyncio.to_thread for CPU parts — looks clean.
RegimeCorrelation.js uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and authHeaders() correctly; data-testid coverage is complete for the feature.
Minor: start_correlation returns 200 'started' on success and relies on _guard_no_running to raise 409 — behavior verified live.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 feature flow tests; 1 flaky GET on transient ingress 502 retried)
